desc: Provides enumeration and provisioning commands for CXL platforms
r: cxl - Provides enumeration and provisioning commands for CXL platforms

-v, --version
Display the version of the cxl utility.
-h, --help
Run the cxl help command.
The cxl utility provides enumeration and provisioning commands for the CXL devices managed by the Linux kernel.
